overall_goal: Prepare the workspace by washing utensils, setting up equipment, and weighing the chicken

goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, moves yogurt out of the way, takes out the chicken, and places it on the counter.

goals.description: Apply dish soap to the knife
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, wets the knife, and squeezes washing up liquid onto it.
The person uses a sponge to scrub both sides of the knife blade, then rinses it under the tap and places it on the counter.

goals.description: Retrieve a knife and chopping board
goals.rationale: The person takes a new knife from the knife block and opens a drawer to access a white chopping board.

goals.description: Retrieve and place the first set of hand towels
goals.rationale: The person opens a cupboard, takes out hand towels, and hangs one on the oven handle while drying their hands.

goals.description: Retrieve and place additional hand towels
goals.rationale: The person opens a drawer and cupboard to get more hand towels, selects one, and places it on the countertop.

goals.description: Clean and set up the measuring scale
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a measuring scale, wipes its surface with a hand towel, and places it on the countertop.

goals.description: Set up a drying rack with a towel
goals.rationale: The person pulls out a drying rack and spreads a hand towel over it.

goals.description: Drain and rinse the bowl of chicken
goals.rationale: The person drains water from a bowl of submerged chicken, removes the chicken, and rinses the bowl in the sink.

goals.description: Weigh the chicken and prepare for cutting
goals.rationale: The person places the rinsed bowl on the scale, weighs the chicken breasts, and then moves a single breast to the chopping board.

goals.description: Store chicken packet, wash hands, and retrieve freezer bags
goals.rationale: The person covers the chicken packet, washes and dries their hands, and opens a cabinet to get freezer bags.
